rules.name: Mobile Scope Enforcement
rules.message: ❌ You are working on MOBILE app. Only files in mobile/ folder are allowed.

rules.name: Backend Forbidden
rules.message: ❌ FORBIDDEN: Backend code cannot be modified by mobile team. Create issue with label 'backend-needed' instead.

rules.name: Frontend Forbidden
rules.message: ❌ FORBIDDEN: Frontend code cannot be modified by mobile team.

rules.name: ML Service Forbidden
rules.message: ❌ FORBIDDEN: ML service code cannot be modified by mobile team.

rules.name: Database Forbidden
rules.message: ❌ FORBIDDEN: Database migrations cannot be created by mobile team.

rules.name: Infrastructure Forbidden
rules.message: ❌ FORBIDDEN: Infrastructure files require team lead approval.

preCommitChecks.message: Verifying only mobile/ files are staged...
preCommitChecks.errorMessage: ❌ Files outside mobile/ are staged. Only mobile/ files allowed.

guidelines.colorConstants: Always use AppColors.* constants, never raw hex colors
guidelines.iconPackage: Always use LucideIcons, never Material Icons
guidelines.borderRadius: All components must have rounded corners (AppRadius.sm/md/lg)
guidelines.architecture: Follow Screen → Provider → Repository → Service pattern
guidelines.imports: Never import from backend/, frontend/, or ml-service/

warnings.backendEndpointMissing: If backend endpoint is missing, create issue with label 'backend-needed' and implement workaround in mobile
warnings.crossServiceImport: Detected import from other service. Duplicate types in mobile/lib/models/ instead
warnings.hardcodedColors: Detected hardcoded color. Use AppColors constants
warnings.materialIcons: Detected Material Icons. Use LucideIcons instead
warnings.noRoundedCorners: Component without rounded corners. Add borderRadius using AppRadius constants
